results.snippet: 🇬🇭 NAIMOS has arrested three Chinese nationals — Deng Jun, 37, Deng Bi Hua, 50, and Deng Bi Qiang, 32 — for allegedly engaging in illegal mining activities on the Tano River at Amenfi West in Ghana’s Western Region. During the operation, authorities seized a Toyota Hilux pickup, weapons, and more than 20 mining machines. The machines were destroyed on site. Ghana NewsPaper Headlines. · 0 comments
